title: Berk-Nash Rationalizability
abstract: arXiv:2505.20708v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Berk--Nash rationalizability, a set-valued counterpart to Berk--Nash equilibrium for environments in which agents may hold misspecified models. A set of behaviors is self-justified if every behavior in the set is optimal under beliefs fitted to data generated within the set. Berk--Nash rationalizability is the largest self-justified set and reduces to standard rationalizability under correct specification and identification. We provide a learning foundation allowing Bayesian agents to learn from different, selectively sampled histories: almost surely, the limit set of play is self-justified. Conversely, under identification, any compact self-justified set can arise as the limit set with arbitrarily high probability. We illustrate how the concept yields informative predictions that are robust across learning procedures, without committing to a specific dynamic or assuming convergence.

translated_abstract: 我们引入了伯克-纳什理性化（Berk-Nash rationalizability）这一概念，它是伯克-纳什均衡在主体可能持有错误设定模型的环境下的集合值对应概念。如果一个行为集合中的每个行为在基于该集合内部生成的数据所拟合出的信念下都是最优的，那么这个行为集合就是自我证成的。伯克-纳什理性化是最大的自我证成集合，并且在模型设定正确且可识别的条件下会退化为标准的理性化概念。我们为其提供了一个学习理论基础，允许贝叶斯主体从不同的、经选择性抽样的历史中进行学习：几乎必然地，博弈的极限集合是自我证成的。反之，在可识别的条件下，任何紧的自我证成集合都可以以任意高的概率作为极限集合出现。我们阐明了该概念如何在无需承诺特定动态过程或假设收敛的情况下，产生在不同学习程序下均稳健的具有信息量的预测。
tldr: 本文提出了伯克-纳什理性化概念，作为错误设定环境下伯克-纳什均衡的集合值对应，证明了博弈的极限集合几乎必然是自我证成的、且任何紧的自我证成集合都可能以任意高概率出现，从而在不依赖特定动态过程或收敛假设的前提下给出稳健的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Berk-Nash rationalizability, a set-valued counterpart to Berk-Nash equilibrium for environments with misspecified models, proving that limit sets of play are self-justified and any compact self-justified set can arise with arbitrarily high probability, thereby delivering robust predictions without committing to specific dynamics or assuming convergence.
